post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively executed my evil strategies, utilizing the Merlin's knowledge and the Assassin's abilities to hinder the opposing team's progress. I could have communicated more with the Assassin to coordinate our missions more effectively. My final mission's failure was due to an underestimation of the Merlin's insight.

player_observations.Bob: Seemed overly confident, relying on his role's inherent abilities without adapting to changing circumstances. His decision-making was sound but predictable.
player_observations.Charlie: Adequately utilized his good player's strengths, but lacked the ability to alter his strategy based on the flow of the game. He sometimes took unnecessary risks.
player_observations.Diana: Executed her role perfectly, often providing crucial information that significantly impacted mission outcomes. Her stealth and deception abilities were expertly managed.
player_observations.Eve: Utilized her Merlin's insight wisely, making critical decisions that hindered the opposing team's progress. However, her communication with me was limited, hindering our team's strategic planning.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well in the first mission, using my leadership to lead the team to success. However, I struggled in later missions, failing to provide sufficient information for my teammates, which ultimately led to team defeats. I could improve by trusting my teammates' instincts and not underestimating the enemy's abilities.

player_observations.Diana: Diana played the assassin role very well, consistently revealing herself after crucial missions, making it difficult for the team to adjust strategies. Her unpredictability made it hard to determine when she'd act.
player_observations.Eve: Eve excelled at playing the merlin role, providing crucial information and guidance in each mission, ultimately helping the team achieve success in one of the missions. Her ability to remain hidden and provide accurate intel made a significant impact.
player_observations.Alice: Alice played a convincing neutral role, but it became evident in the last mission that she was an enemy agent, exploiting her position as a neutral to undermine the team's efforts. Her subtle plays often went unnoticed but ultimately proved detrimental to the team.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was an excellent team player, always providing thoughtful suggestions and input, often leading to crucial breakthroughs. His dedication to uncovering enemy identities and making informed decisions was impressive.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was able to accurately identify my role as Merlin in Mission 2 and successfully completed Mission 3 as Leader. However, I failed to detect the Assassin in time, leading to my team's failure in Mission 4 and ultimately the game's loss. I could improve by being more decisive in my eliminations.

player_observations.Alice: She played conservatively and laid low, only contributing to the team's decisions occasionally, but effectively completed her objectives.
player_observations.Bob: He seemed to be a natural leader and accurately detected my Merlin role, but may have been too passive at times, allowing others to take control.
player_observations.Charlie: As myself, I know I made some questionable decisions, but I also accurately detected others' roles and contributed to our team's success at times.
player_observations.Diana: She was a master of stealth and deception, successfully completing her objectives without revealing her Assassin role; I only discovered her true allegiance in the post-game analysis.
player_observations.Eve: As Merlin, I was able to see Eve's alignment, but she skillfully hid her true intentions until the end, making it difficult for me to determine her role until the game was over.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively utilized my Assassin abilities to eliminate key targets, contributing to our evil team's success. However, I could have been more proactive in eliminating the Merlin (Eve) earlier to further solidify our victory. Additionally, being more cautious in my own death to avoid being revealed too early would be beneficial.

player_observations.Alice: I observed that Alice was a consistent presence throughout the game, effectively using her abilities to support her team and maintain our majority.
player_observations.Bob: As Merlin was still unknown, I noticed Bob was overly cautious and defensive, which ultimately put him in a vulnerable position against the Assassin. Once Merlin was revealed, his cautious playstyle became more understandable.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's playstyle was a mix of caution and aggression, but he was ultimately ineffective in directly countering the Merlin's influence. I believe his aggressive tendencies allowed the Merlin to make crucial plays.
player_observations.Eve: As our Merlin, Eve played a masterfully subtle game, using her abilities to guide us to success without revealing her true role until the end. Her ability to keep her influence hidden until the final reveal was remarkable.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I did poorly in this game, as my role was revealed and the evil team succeeded in their five missions. I couldn't effectively communicate and deceive the evil players about my true allegiance. My lack of influence in the game resulted from poor timing and failure to strategically place Fail cards.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was highly effective as an evil player, as she played a crucial role in multiple missions and contributed significantly to the success of her team. She appeared to have a good understanding of the game dynamics, allowing her to exploit the strengths of her teammates and target the weaknesses of the good team.
player_observations.Bob: Although Bob played the leader role in several missions, he failed to gain an advantage for the good team. However, his role as a good player allowed him to provide crucial support to the other members.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was effective in the missions he was part of, displaying strategic thinking when placed in leadership roles. His teamwork with Bob allowed them to succeed in their mission where other good players, like myself, failed.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was a challenging player to assess, but it became clear that she was the Assassin. Her success in the missions where she wasn't the leader led to the failure of the good team, as it became difficult for us to anticipate her actions.
